scope: One authored clean synthetic WAV; no physical recording or simulated channel test
phrase: Is it possible that it is not true that Orin is not curious about this map [2] and Eli came to understand what Nora said [0]?

members.criterion: The experiencer has epistemic interest in the contextual inquiry: resolving some contextually relevant uncertainty about the topic is itself motivationally attractive, rather than wanted solely for a separate practical outcome. Instrumental motives may coexist. This does not require pleasure, current attention, a conscious feeling, intention, action, successful discovery or complete ignorance of the topic.
limitations: Context must identify the topic and relevant questions.
This draft epistemic reading is not oddness, sensory novelty seeking or purely instrumental information demand.

result.criterion: Grasps the intended meaning of contextually selected content conveyed by the anchor; does not assert that the conveyed claims are true.
limitations: Contextually selected content is not supplied or verified as a real-world fact.
No original spelling or external referent identity is recovered from phonemes.
Draft comprehension predicate; broader cognitive grammar and canonical admission remain open.
Draft completed transition; not an assertion of understanding at speech time or permanent retention.
Content source restrictions are retained, without fabricating the referenced speech or its truth.
No temporal order or causal relationship is asserted between members.
Shared reference sounds do not establish external identity; each member retains its own contextual references.
